texts.zh:
思绪的沙粒流过我们。我们认出了无尽之潮汐粗粝的面孔。

祂潮起潮落，以永恒的必然性侵蚀着面对的一切，然后等待新的沉积。

祂在逝去之后的重现，让我们感到一种真正的复兴感。
texts.en:
Grains of thought pass over us. We recognize the abrasive presence of the Endless Tide.

It ebbs and flows, eroding all before it with an eternal inevitability, before redepositing anew.

Re-emerging in the wake of its passing, we feel a sense of true rejuvenation.
